RTSP::method
Description
Returns the method/command (for example, DESCRIBE, PLAY) from the
current RTSP request.
Syntax
RTSP
::
method
RTSP::method

Examples
rule
xxx

when
RTSP_REQUEST
{
puts
[
RTSP
::
method

}
}
